summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation has shifted from brittle CSS-selector scripts toward LLM-driven extraction, natural-language queries, and autonomous browser agents that can navigate and adapt to page changes. The modern landscape blends developer-first APIs (Firecrawl, Browserbase, AgentQL) with marketplace and no-code platforms (Apify, Octoparse, Browse.ai) and open-source automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer) now commonly paired with LLMs. Tools increasingly target RAG pipelines and AI agents, offering clean markdown output and managed cloud browsers to handle anti-bot and scaling challenges.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source; costs only arise from self-hosted infrastructure or paired cloud browser services
ai_features: Commonly paired with LLMs for autonomous navigation and extraction
Foundation for AI agent frameworks and browser-use tools
MCP server integration for AI agents
tools.best_for: Developers needing full programmatic control over browser automation, often as the base layer for AI scraping agents

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans starting around $16/mo (Hobby) scaling to Standard/Growth tiers
ai_features: LLM-ready markdown and structured output
Natural-language and schema-based extraction (/extract)
AI-powered crawling optimized for RAG pipelines
strengths: Clean, LLM-ready output out of the box
Simple API for crawl, scrape, and extract
tools.best_for: Feeding clean web data into LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free $5 monthly credits; paid plans from $49/mo (Starter) with usage-based pricing
ai_features: AI-focused Actors and integrations
LLM extraction Actors available in the marketplace
MCP server and AI agent tooling
tools.best_for: Running and scaling diverse scraping jobs via a marketplace of ready-made and custom Actors

tools.name: Puppeteer
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source; infrastructure costs only
ai_features: Frequently integrated with LLMs for agentic browsing
Base layer for AI browser-automation frameworks
tools.best_for: Chromium-based automation and scraping within Node.js environments

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited browser hours; paid plans from $39/mo scaling with usage
ai_features: Stagehand AI framework for natural-language browser actions
LLM-driven autonomous browsing
Integrates with AI agents for web tasks
strengths: Managed headless cloud browsers at scale
Built for AI agents and automation
tools.best_for: Running cloud browser infrastructure for AI agents and automated web tasks

tools.name: ScrapeGraphAI
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with credits; API paid plans starting around $20/mo
ai_features: LLM-powered graph-based extraction pipelines
Natural-language prompts to define scraping logic
Structured output generation via LLMs
strengths: Open-source Python library with strong growth
Flexible integration with multiple LLM providers
tools.best_for: Developers who want to define scraping logic via natural-language prompts in Python

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.pricing_paid: 14-day free trial; paid plans starting around $299/mo
ai_features: AI/ML-based automatic page classification and extraction
Knowledge Graph with entity extraction
Natural-language querying of structured web data
strengths: Strong for enterprise data and entity resolution
tools.best_for: Enterprise-scale structured data extraction and knowledge graph building

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited API calls; paid plans from around $99/mo
ai_features: Natural-language / AI query language to locate page elements
Resilient AI-driven selectors that adapt to page changes
Built for AI agents and automated web interaction
strengths: Semantic element querying instead of brittle selectors
Integrates with Playwright and automation tools
tools.best_for: Building resilient AI agents that locate and interact with web elements semantically

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan with limited tasks; paid plans from $99/mo (Standard)
ai_features: AI-assisted auto-detection of data fields
AI web scraping assistant for workflow building
Template and smart extraction features
tools.best_for: No-code users needing visual, scheduled scraping without programming

tools.name: Browse.ai
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan with limited credits; paid plans from $48.75/mo (Starter)
ai_features: AI-assisted robot training by demonstration
Automatic data field detection
Change monitoring and alerting powered by automation
tools.best_for: No-code website monitoring and data extraction with minimal setup

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open-source; infrastructure costs only
ai_features: LLM-friendly markdown output for RAG
LLM-based extraction strategies
Natural-language schema extraction
strengths: Very high GitHub star growth and community momentum
tools.best_for: Open-source LLM-ready crawling and extraction for RAG applications
